title: Breadth-First Search And Depth-First Search
summary: Learn BFS and DFS from first principles, implement both in Python and TypeScript, and choose the right traversal in graph, tree, grid, and interview problems.
audience: Developers preparing for coding interviews or strengthening practical graph and tree traversal fundamentals.

units.title: BFS And DFS Fundamentals
units.summary: Build a shared traversal mental model, then compare queue-based BFS with stack-based or recursive DFS.

units.title: Interview Patterns And Tradeoffs
units.summary: Apply traversal to grids, shortest paths, dependencies, and problems where BFS and DFS are both correct but behave differently.
